tool_input.message:
The Implementation note is written and correct, but I need to flag how it landed: it's in HEAD (commit 1a82a12 on fix/spec-backed-enforcement), verified via `git show HEAD:docs/spec-writeset-admission.tex`, fuzz-clean (0 errors) and pdflatex-clean (exits 0, two passes, no undefined references) — but it landed as part of commit 1a82a12, "fix(mission): extend ethos-8ady fix to three sibling lint heuristics," authored by J Freeman, not as a dedicated commit of mine.

What happened: this is a shared working tree with other sessions committing concurrently. I ran `git add docs/spec-writeset-admission.tex` and staged my edit, but before my `git commit` executed, another session's commit (1a82a12, unrelated Go changes to the lint heuristics) evidently ran `git add -A`/`git commit -a` and swept my staged doc change in alongside it. My own commit command then failed with "nothing to commit" (exit 1) because the content was already committed by the other party. I did not catch this until after the fact, since `git status`/`git diff` on the file showed a clean match to HEAD once I investigated the failure.

I did not attempt to rewrite history to separate this out — that would be a destructive operation on shared branch history requiring your explicit consent, and the content itself is correct, present, and verified, just attributed to the wrong commit message and author. Let me know if you want it split out via a follow-up commit or left as-is.

Content added (§Containment, new "Implementation note" subsection): documents that the merged pathContainedBy widens `absolute = zfalse` to flag equality `absolute(file) = absolute(entry)`, because the verifier allowlist legitimately carries one absolute entry (the verifier's own contract.yaml, appended by verifierAllowlistSplit). Confirms ENTRY's own scope is unchanged (validator-checked entries, always relative), so for every entry this document models, flag equality and the stricter zfalse reading are the same predicate — the existing schema is a correct, non-divergent special case, not stale. Records the rejected alternative (strict zfalse would break a verifier writing its own contract) and confirms ethos-vaib's property survives either reading. Cites conflict.go:367-410, conflict.go:377-379 (the code's own comment naming this document), internal/hook/subagent_start.go:457-489, conflict_test.go:599, and pretooluse_test.go:455. Prose-only — no schema changed, no ProB counts affected.

make check is green on the current tree (verified separately from the file-specific checks above, since other unrelated in-flight changes are present from concurrent sessions I did not touch).
